schema:
CREATE TABLE city (
  area,
  city_id,
  city_name,
  population,
  state
);

CREATE TABLE customer (
  address,
  annual_revenue,
  city,
  cust_id,
  cust_name,
  cust_type,
  phone,
  state,
  zip
);

CREATE TABLE driver (
  address,
  city,
  driver_id,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  phone,
  state,
  zip_code
);

CREATE TABLE shipment (
  city_id,
  cust_id,
  driver_id,
  ship_date,
  ship_id,
  truck_id,
  weight
);
